name: Bandcamp for Artists Direct Store Upload Route
paymentBoundaryObserved: Artist accounts are free, but revenue share, payment processor fees, PayPal/payout, tax setup and optional Bandcamp Pro at $10/month require owner review.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for desktop sign-up/login, artist identity, upload rights, human-created-content policy, pricing, PayPal/payout, tax, direct-to-fan store terms, optional Pro, merch/shipping and editorial-discovery boundaries.
